title: Copy-site source register
statement: The source register of a copy site is assigned as follows: $X$ and $QP$ read registers $1$; $T$ reads register $2$; $TC$ reads register $4$; $CN$, $CM$, $CU$, and $CT$ read register $6$; $MN$ reads register $7$; $KM$ reads register $8$; $UI$ reads register $11$; and $TU$ reads register $13$.
